{{Top|leg}}
{{Otheruses|Secession}}
The '''Secession Worlds''' was a propagandistic name given by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to the few systems that declared allegiance to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], after [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma's]] [[Declaration of Rebellion/Legends|Declaration of Rebellion]]. The [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Starfleet]] quickly crushed them, along with the disaster of [[Operation Domino]], convinced the Rebellion to remain underground for the rest of its history.<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
